title: Veere Di Wedding
desc: Kalindi's friends Avni, Sakshi, and Meera reunite for her wedding. Sakshi takes them to Thailand, where they rediscover themselves and confront their personal struggles.

title: Anamika
desc: A writer saves an injured woman who has lost her memory and insists she is his wife. While searching for her true identity, he slowly falls in love with her for real.

title: Darlings
desc: Hamza and Badru's love marriage spirals into abuse and alcoholism. When his cruelty sparks a tragedy, Badru transforms her pain into power and sets out for revenge.

title: Vedaa
desc: Vedaa, facing caste discrimination, trains as a boxer under Abhimanyu to seek justice for her siblings' murder, fighting both societal bias and the killers with courage and determination.

title: Aparichit-The Stranger
desc: Ramanujam, a lawyer with multiple personalities, turns vigilante at night. Guided by Garuda Purana, he hunts down criminals and exposes antisocial elements in society.

title: I Want To Talk
desc: Arjun, a marketing executive in America, struggles with his daughter. His life changes when he is diagnosed with throat cancer, forcing him to confront relationships, words, and mortality.
